theorem cambia (p q : Prop) (h : p ∧ q) : q ∧ p := by
  constructor
  · exact h.2
  · exact h.1

theorem izq (p q : Prop) (hp : p) : p ∨ q := by
  left
  exact hp

#print izq

theorem cambia : ∀ (p q : Prop), p ∧ q → q ∧ p :=
fun p q h => ⟨h.right, h.left⟩

theorem izq : ∀ (p q : Prop), p → p ∨ q :=
fun p q hp => Or.inl hp
